text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I should have been able to bring out more. 
Of my own power.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, let's analyze the race... We may 
need to rethink our training plan.
choice_data_list:
Your running was great, luck just wasn't 
on our side.

of luck.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Luck—yet for the truly strong, uncertain 
variables are of no consequence.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
With overwhelming strength, anything can 
be brushed aside.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If it was swayed by luck, then it simply 
means I lacked the strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Now I see what needs to be 
prioritized. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you've already devised a 
strategy, then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let us return. Every second is precious.
